    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">《手搓》线程池</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText"><div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一什么是手搓线程池">一、什么是《手搓》线程池</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>手搓线程池并不是用来完全代替系统线程池的</li>
<li>你可以把手搓线程池看做系统线程池的一部分</li>
<li>就好比在东海用集装箱搞养殖</li>
<li>一个集装箱里养鱼</li>
<li>另一个集装箱里养虾</li>
<li>搞好隔离,鱼虾都不耽搁</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二最常用线程池的场景是什么">二、最常用线程池的场景是什么</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>当然是Task,是用TaskFactory.StartNew方法创建Task</li>
<li>TaskFactory也可以手搓</li>
<li>手搓TaskFactory就需要手搓TaskScheduler</li>
<li>前一篇文章的手搓EventBus里面包含了手搓的TaskScheduler</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="三手搓taskscheduler">三、手搓TaskScheduler</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrentTaskScheduler就是一个手搓的TaskScheduler</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class ConcurrentTaskScheduler(ConcurrentOptions options)
    : TaskScheduler, IProcessor
{
    // ...
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="1-赶紧测试一下">1. 赶紧测试一下</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>测试失败,上来一闷棍</li>
<li>触发超时异常</li>
<li>Task就没执行啊！！！</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ConcurrentOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 10 };
var scheduler = new ConcurrentTaskScheduler(options);
var factory = new TaskFactory(scheduler);
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Add(1, 2));
var result = await TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfTimeout(task, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));

public static int Add(int a, int b)
{
    var result = a + b;
    Console.WriteLine($"reslut:{result}");
    return result;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-测试用例改进一下">2. 测试用例改进一下</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>增加scheduler.Run测试通过</li>
<li>但是加一个任务要调用一次Run是不是太麻烦了</li>
<li>现在就该手搓线程池出马了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ConcurrentOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 10 };
var scheduler = new ConcurrentTaskScheduler(options);
var factory = new TaskFactory(scheduler);
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Add(1, 2));
scheduler.Run();
var result = await TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfTimeout(task, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-手搓线程池测试">3. 手搓线程池测试</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrentJobService就是那个手搓线程池</li>
<li>计算九九乘法表,每次算术0.1秒,1秒结束</li>
<li>其一说明线程池起作用了,不用手动调用Run了</li>
<li>其二线程池提供了并发处理能力,平均并发为8</li>
<li>仔细观察结果会发现,最开始的并发是1,后面越来越大,最大并发是10</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 10 };
var scheduler = new ConcurrentTaskScheduler(options);
var factory = new TaskFactory(scheduler);
var jobService = new ConcurrentJobService(scheduler, options);
jobService.Start();
Start(factory);

private void Start(TaskFactory factory)
{
    for (int i = 1; i &lt; 10; i++)
    {
        for (int j = 1; j &lt; 10; j++)
        {
            int a = i, b = j;
            factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Multiply(a, b));
        }
    }
}
public int Multiply(int a, int b)
{
    var result = a * b;
    _output.WriteLine($"{a} x {b} = {result},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    Thread.Sleep(100);
    return result;
}

// 1 x 1 = 1,01:58:55.832
// 1 x 2 = 2,01:58:55.944
// 1 x 3 = 3,01:58:55.944
// 1 x 4 = 4,01:58:56.054
// 1 x 5 = 5,01:58:56.054
// 1 x 6 = 6,01:58:56.054
// 1 x 7 = 7,01:58:56.054
// 1 x 8 = 8,01:58:56.165
// 1 x 9 = 9,01:58:56.165

<h2 id="四揭秘手搓线程池">四、揭秘手搓线程池</h2>
<h3 id="1-concurrentjobservice">1. ConcurrentJobService</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这个名字是不是很奇怪</li>
<li>线程池不应该叫ThreadPool吗?</li>
<li>原来线程池里面还藏着一个线程池!!!</li>
<li>ConcurrentJobService是对线程池的封装,它比真的线程池还好用</li>
<li>所以笔者直接叫它线程池</li>
<li>笔者不会直接使用ThreadJobPool,而是用ConcurrentJobService</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class ConcurrentJobService : ReduceJobService
{
    ThreadJobPool Pool { get; }
    IProcessor Processor { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-concurrentjobservice工作原理">2. ConcurrentJobService工作原理</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrentJobService本身就是一个线程,可以称为主线程</li>
<li>ConcurrentJobService执行成功就从Pool里面激活一个线程</li>
<li>ConcurrentJobService执行失败就休眠一段时间,通过ReduceTime配置(默认50毫秒)</li>
<li>主线程就像找食物的搜索狼,线程池就像狼窝,狼窝里面都是贪吃的吃货狼</li>
<li>搜索狼找到食物就开吃,每吃一口就狼嚎</li>
<li>听到一声狼嚎,狼窝里面就出来一个吃货狼</li>
<li>吃货狼也是每吃一口就狼嚎</li>
<li>这是指数数列的关系(很快就能达到最高并发)</li>
<li>吃货狼吃完了就回狼窝睡觉</li>
<li>搜索狼吃完了就慢腾腾的继续搜索(相当于心跳包)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="五不用taskfactory能用手搓线程池吗">五、不用TaskFactory能用手搓线程池吗?</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>当然能</li>
<li>ActionThreadPool提供类系统线程池效果,传个委托就行</li>
<li>其实就是实现IProcessor,把需要做的事情包装进去就行了</li>
<li>自己再手搓一个也不难</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-单并发测试">1. 单并发测试</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel设置为1</li>
<li>通过Add添加要执行的委托</li>
<li>记得要调用Start方法启动线程,否则不会执行的哟</li>
<li>所有action都在Thread31上执行</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var pool = new ActionThreadPool(options);
pool.Start();
pool.Add(() =&gt; Hello("张三"));
pool.Add(() =&gt; Hello("李四"));

void Hello(string name)
{
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Hello {name},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
}

// Thread31 Hello 张三,10:41:40.145
// Thread31 Hello 李四,10:41:40.147
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-多并发测试">2. 多并发测试</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel设置为4</li>
<li>一次性添加了100个action</li>
<li>所有action都在Thread31、Thread32、Thread33和Thread34上执行</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 4 };
var pool = new ActionThreadPool(options);
pool.Start();
for (int i = 0; i &lt; 100; i++)
{
    var user = "User" + i;
    pool.Add(() =&gt; Hello(user));
}

void Hello(string name)
{
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Hello {name},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    Thread.Sleep(1);
}

// Thread31 Hello User0,10:56:12.014

<h3 id="3-用actionthreadpool能不能知道它啥时候执行完呢">3. 用ActionThreadPool,能不能知道它啥时候执行完呢</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这不就是TaskFactory做的事情吗?</li>
<li>现在强制ActionThreadPool能做到吗?</li>
<li>山人自有妙计,完全可以实现</li>
<li>用TaskWrapper把action包装成Task再让ActionThreadPool执行就OK了</li>
<li>TaskWrapper是用TaskCompletionSource简单封装而来</li>
<li>如果action执行有异常,await也是会抛异常的哟</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var pool = new ActionThreadPool(options);
pool.Start();
var wrapper1 = TaskWrapper.Wrap(() =&gt; Hello("张三"));
var wrapper2 = TaskWrapper.Wrap(() =&gt; Hello("李四"));
pool.Add(wrapper1.Run);
pool.Add(wrapper2.Run);
await Task.WhenAll(wrapper1.Original, wrapper2.Original);

// Thread31 Hello 张三,11:58:47.600
// Thread31 Hello 李四,11:58:47.617
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-用actionthreadpool能执行func并拿到结果吗">4. 用ActionThreadPool能执行Func并拿到结果吗</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>当然也能</li>
<li>还是要用山人妙计</li>
<li>用TaskWrapper包装后再让ActionThreadPool执行</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var pool = new ActionThreadPool(options);
pool.Start();
var wrapper = TaskWrapper.Wrap(() =&gt; Multiply(9, 9));
pool.Add(wrapper.Run);
var result = await wrapper.Original;
Assert.Equal(81, result);

int Multiply(int a, int b)
{
    var result = a * b;
    _output.WriteLine($"{a} x {b} = {result},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    return result;
}

// 9 x 9 = 81,11:27:54.537
</code></pre>
